column2: Inyandiko n'amamaza y'ijwi/video 1:1 — nta nimero ya telefone, imfunguzo n'inyandiko kuri mudasobwa yawe.
Ghal Bol: mu gihe nyacyo, mu bwihisho, ubutumwa n'amamaza kuva kuri mudasobwa ujya kundi

Igicuruzwa gisohoka munsi y'ikirango cya Ghal Bol — inyandiko y'ibanga kuva kuri mudasobwa ujya kundi, inyemezabwishyu zo gutanga no gusoma, n'amamaza y'ijwi na video y'ahantu hagati y'abari kuri murandasi. Izina risanzwe ry'aporogaramu ni Ghal Bol (com.ghalbol).
Ikiganiro kuva ku mpera kugeza ku yindi
Ubutumwa burashyirwa ikimenyetso kuri mudasobwa yawe. Agasanduku ko gutanga gafata gusa inyandiko y'ibanga idasobanutse kugeza uwakira ayemeza.
Amamaza ahurira kuva kuri mudasobwa ujya kundi kuri LAN iyo bishoboka, bitabaye ibyo binyura ku kiraro cyoroshye cyo guhuza kitigeza gikura ibanga kuri media.
Buri gushyiraho gukora indangamuntu y'ibanga y'ahantu. Tumira ukoresheje QR cyangwa umurongo — nta nimero ya telefone no kwinjira muri mbuga nkoranyambaga.
Sikanisha rimwe. Huza iyo uri kuri murandasi.
Umushyitsi asikanisha QR y'umukiriya (cyangwa afungura umurongo w'ubutumire). Umushyitsi abika urufunguzo rusange rw'umukiriya akohereza. QR ku mpande zombi ntibikenewe na rimwe.
Sangiza umurongo wawe https://ghalbol.com/connect/… cyangwa QR biva mu Butumire muri Ghal Bol.
Babifungura muri Ghal Bol (cyangwa babanza gushyiraho bava kuri Play / Linux).
Iyo bombi bashobora kugerwaho, ikiganiro n'amamaza bihurira — ku mamaza inzira za LAN na WAN zigenda hamwe.
Pake za Windows zikubakwa mu mwanya w'akazi umwe. Igicuruzwa gisohoka ku rubuga ni pake ya desktop ya Linux; Android isohoka kuri Google Play nka com.ghalbol.
Shiraho Ghal Bol biva kuri Play. App Links zemejwe zifungura ubutumire mu porogaramu iyo bishoboka.
Fungura ububiko bw'isosiyo, hanyuma ./install.sh (ku mukoresha) cyangwa ./run.sh kugira ngo ugerageze aho uri.

Gotigin ni ikirango (Aho ikoranabuhanga rihurira n'ubuvumbuzi). GOTIGIN SOFTWARE & HARDWARE PRIVATE LIMITED ni ikigo. Ghal Bol ni ikirango cy'ibicuruzwa by'itumanaho; uru rubuga ni ghalbol.com. Umbutumwa ni icyo gisohoka uyu munsi. Amazina ya pake n'urubuga biguma ghalbol — ijambo rimwe. Nta kirango ka camel-case katandukanye.
Pake y'umusaruro x86_64. Fungura ububiko hanyuma ukore ./install.sh (ku mukoresha, muri ~/.local) cyangwa ./run.sh kugira ngo ugerageze aho uri.
Byafunguwe imbere ya porogaramu ikindi (urugero WhatsApp)
Iyi mushakisha yubatswe ntishobora gufungura Ghal Bol. Kanda urutonde hanyuma ufungure iyi paji muri Chrome, cyangwa wandukure umurongo wa porogaramu ukawashyira muri Ghal Bol → Jya.
Hasi kanda Fungura muri Ghal Bol. Niba ntacyo kibaye, wandukure umurongo wa porogaramu ukawashyira muri Ghal Bol (Jya).
Injira muri Ghal Bol. Amahitamo yose — imeri, Google, Microsoft, GitHub, cyangwa telefone.
Komeza ukoresheje imeri, utanga serivisi, cyangwa telefone.
Koresha ijambo ry’ibanga rifite nibura inyuguti 6.
Imeri cyangwa ijambo ry’ibanga si byo.
Iyi domeni ntiyemerewe kuri Firebase Auth.
Wagerageje inshuro nyinshi cyane. Ongera ugerageze nyuma.
Koresha nimero ya telefone yuzuye ifite kode y’igihugu (urugero +91…).
Iyo kode ya SMS si yo cyangwa yararengeje igihe.
Imeri ntiraremezwa — reba agasanduku k’ubutumwa bwawe
Imeri yo kwemeza yoherejwe — reba agasanduku k'ubutumwa bwawe
Nta kintu kiri kuri iyi aderesi. Umurongo w'ubutumire usa na ghalbol.com/connect/… — reba ko wandukuwe wose.
